purpose: Teach: 芥川/ビルマ/ベネズエラ/茅ヶ崎/ナイロビ/鈴鹿/ホノルル/テレビ東京

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが芥川龍之介の本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father lent you that Akutagawa Ryunosuke book, didn't he.
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. Soft opening. No urgency — she's noticing something small he did. A slight lift at the end, affirming rather than questioning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとビルマの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a picture book about Burma with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, immediate. No filter between thought and speech. Quick tempo, genuine excitement. The kind of child-voice that expects to be heard and received without performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがベネズエラのニュースをご覧になってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was reading about the news from Venezuela.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wondering. She's reflecting back what she noticed — not interrogating. Soft pace. A small pause before 'Venezuela,' like she's choosing the word carefully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと茅ヶ崎の海行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to the beach at Chigasaki.
lines.style: Unguarded joy. Fast, overlapping words almost. Pure reporting — no thought to how it lands. The voice of a child who trusts he'll be delighted with him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがナイロビ駐在のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told you about his time stationed in Nairobi.
lines.style: Tender reflection, almost nostalgic. She's listening to stories about his past coming alive for their son. Slow, deliberate. The care of someone holding something precious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと鈴鹿サーキットのF1中継観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched the F1 broadcast from Suzuka Circuit.
lines.style: Unfiltered delight. Quick cadence, no hesitation. The excitement in his voice is innocent — he's sharing something that mattered, expecting her to understand why.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがホノルル旅行の写真を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father showed you photos from his trip to Honolulu.
lines.style: Soft warmth, almost gentle awe. She's noticing these moments of connection between them. Slow, intentional pacing. A slight tenderness on 'showed you' — witnessing something lovely.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとテレビ東京の経済番組観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched an economics program on TV Tokyo with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact sharing. Natural pace, unselfconscious. He's reporting something true without weighing whether it sounds interesting — that's the whole point.
